# BookConv

> Free online ebook format converter supporting 28+ formats across ebooks, documents, and images. No registration, no watermarks, no file-size limits for most conversions. Powered by the Calibre engine and runs entirely in your browser.

## Supported Formats
EPUB, AZW3, MOBI, PDF, DOC, DOCX, RTF, TXT, HTML, FB2, LIT, CBR, DJVU, JPG, PNG

## About
BookConv is a free, browser-based ebook converter. Files are transferred over encrypted HTTPS and automatically deleted within 1 hour of conversion. No account is required for free conversions. The service is built on the open-source Calibre conversion engine and supports ebooks, documents, and images.

### Privacy & Trust
- No registration required for free conversions.
- Uploaded files are encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and deleted automatically within 1 hour.
- Files with DRM are rejected on upload; conversion only works on DRM-free files the user owns.
- No watermarks are added to output files.
